storyscope.note: Distinct dry voice; missing REBECCA box and the anonymous woman paying to February land hard, unstated.

writing-skill.note: Restrained and honest; labeled bunk-bed bolts are lovely, but the arc is familiar and low-voltage.

baseline.note: Tagged repairs and 'ASK' bike are memorable, but dialogue over-explains and the wheel-holding ending is too neat.

merged.note: Ledger gives real moral friction; MISC — GOOD and the purse swap are sharp. Slightly busy with local color.
